_comment: INFRA-PERM unblock. An agent cannot write .claude/settings.json itself (the harness guards self-escalation of permissions / the whole .claude/ dir), so this proposed allowlist is staged here as a normal repo file. OPERATOR: review, then copy it into place (the .claude/ dir does not exist yet, so create it first):  mkdir -p .claude && cp ralph/INFRA-PERM-settings.proposed.json .claude/settings.json  — this lets the autonomous Ralph loop run its verify gate (pytest+ruff) and commit without per-command approval. Scope is dev/test/VCS + read-only/research hlbot subcommands. Deny takes precedence over allow in Claude Code, so the dangerous hlbot subcommands and `make deploy` are explicitly denied: nothing that trips/clears KILL (`hlbot kill`/`resume`), writes agent_state modes (`hlbot supervisor` — auto-promotion is the supervisor's job, never the loop's), places live orders (`hlbot run`/`tick`/`femr-tick`), or deploys/sudo (`make deploy`). Push is intentionally NOT allowed (the loop script handles push). NOTE: `uv run python:*` is allowed because the loop must run tests/ad-hoc checks — that grant is necessarily broad, so the real guardrails remain the hard rules + CI gate-minima diff checks + the separate clone, not this file.
